triples.evidence_text: Where crankcase oil mist detection arrangements are fitted to engines, they are to be of an approved type and tested in accordance with Appendix 4-2-1-A3.

triples.head_surface: oil mist detection system and arrangements
triples.tail_surface: installed in accordance with the engine designer’s and oil mist manufacturer’s instructions/ recommendations
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 按发动机设计师及油雾制造商说明安装
triples.evidence_text: The oil mist detection system and arrangements are to be installed in accordance with the engine designer’s and oil mist manufacturer’s instructions/ recommendations.

triples.tail_surface: capable of being tested on the test bed and onboard under engine at standstill and engine running at normal operating conditions
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 可在试验台及船上停机与正常运行工况下测试
triples.evidence_text: Oil mist detection and alarm systems are to be capable of being tested on the test bed and onboard under engine at standstill and engine running at normal operating conditions in accordance with manufacturer’s test procedures.

triples.head_surface: foreseeable functional failure in the equipment and installation arrangements
triples.head_canonical_zh: 设备及安装布置的可预见功能故障
triples.evidence_text: The oil mist detection arrangements are to provide an alarm indication in the event of a foreseeable functional failure in the equipment and installation arrangements.

triples.head_surface: lenses fitted in the equipment and used in determination of the oil mist level have been partially obscured
triples.head_canonical_zh: 设备中用于测定油雾浓度的透镜部分遮蔽
triples.evidence_text: The oil mist detection system is to provide an indication that any lenses fitted in the equipment and used in determination of the oil mist level have been partially obscured to a degree that will affect the reliability of the information and alarm indication.

triples.tail_surface: tested in the presence of the Surveyor when installed on the test bed and onboard
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 在验船师在场下于试验台及船上安装后测试
triples.evidence_text: The equipment, together with detectors, is to be tested in the presence of the Surveyor when installed on the test bed and onboard to demonstrate that the detection and alarm system functionally operates.
